findings.summary: Gimlet-L outperforms Ostler on both benchmarks, with a higher pass rate on Kiln-Py (66.0% vs 61.2%) and on Kiln-PyX (31.1% vs 23.5%).
findings.scope: Kiln-Py and Kiln-PyX, pass rate (%), greedy decoding, one sample per problem
findings.caveats: No statistical tests reported; differences are descriptive only.

findings.summary: Gimlet-S, despite having fewer parameters (3B), achieves a pass rate close to Ostler (13B) on Kiln-Py (58.7% vs 61.2%) and on Kiln-PyX (21.9% vs 23.5%), with Ostler slightly higher in both cases.
